post.description: Validates and updates profile fields for a pending user, marking their registration status as COMPLETED. Disallows repeated registration requests and duplicate email/phone numbers.

parameters.name: X-Client-User-Id
parameters.description: Client identity UUID from external provider/client

200.description: User profile successfully registered and marked COMPLETED

400.description: Validation failure on request body or missing/malformed X-Client-User-Id header

404.description: User not found for provided client identity; synchronization via /me is required first

409.description: Conflict: User is already registered or email/phone is already in use

UpdateVideoSessionRequest.description: Request payload for updating a video consultation session status or timing

sessionStatus.description: Updated session status (e.g. ACTIVE, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the video call actually started

endedAt.description: Timestamp when the video call concluded

VideoSessionResponse.description: Response representation of a video consultation session

message.example: Validation failed for one or more fields

validationErrors.description: Field-level validation error details when applicable

Address.description: User physical address value object embedded in User

isDefault.description: Whether this is the user's default address

UpdateUserRequest.description: Request payload for updating an existing user's profile details

address.description: Physical address details of the user

UserResponse.description: Response payload representing the authenticated or synchronized user

clientIdentityId.description: Client identity UUID from external client or identity provider

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated

CreateSpecializationRequest.description: Request body for creating a medical specialization
